pages.text: The movement theorems include Hop, Dash, Vector Leap, Recoil, and Blink. Their formulas appear directly in the programmer catalog.$(br2)Ray Marker marks a hit point. Blink raycasts up to 12 blocks and teleports beside the hit block when there is room.

pages.text: $(li)scale_vector(Vec3, Number) -> Vec3$(li)raycast_block(Player, Number) -> RayHit$(li)ray_hit_position(RayHit) -> Vec3$(li)blink_self_to_hit(Player, RayHit) -> Unit$(br2)Runtime clamps movement, checks blink collision, and charges Blink's default 1 ender pearl cost only after a successful survival cast.
